engine.modifications: None: copied source bytes. Mixed float state / double biquad coefficients and histories selected by upstream header; conventional covariance update.

firmware.thermal_source: src/sensor/calibration/tcal_mls_lut.c:MLS top10, double linear fit, five-slot local-slope cache, 0.5C LUT; calibration.c:259-340 subtract curve/static offset, optional explicit legacy offset, then sensitivity
firmware.revision_note: HEAD identifiers are provenance only. Working-tree equality to commits is not asserted; hashes identify actual source bytes.

native_build.compiler: cc build dependency, platform C compiler
native_build.CMSIS_DSP: Exact scalar subset and sine table, see cmsis/provenance.json and Apache-2.0 cmsis/LICENSE. Host precise arithmetic, not target-specific -Ofast/ARM instruction equivalence.
native_build.initialization: Cold start independently per unknown-duration segment; retained live state unavailable.
native_build.parameter_bridge: All 25 VQF parameters are explicitly passed from validated ReplayParams to the unchanged kernel. Native defaults retain the original 8aa61a6 firmware profile; imported/preset/custom parameters do not redefine that baseline.

reconstruction.clock: Nominal raw TX interval plus sequence span, not receiver arrival time or chip ODR
reconstruction.gyro_default: One fixed-period gyro update per reconstructed raw interval. First/segment-start cumulative quaternion has no known gyro interval and bypasses compensation/integration. Firmware profile at effective recorded rate, not full-rate live reproduction.
reconstruction.gyro_override: Explicit constant-rate subevent approximation; bounded at 256x raw TX rate
reconstruction.accel: Only received nonzero fresh observations; fixed actual metadata/overridden accelerometer period
reconstruction.mag: Only received nonzero new-mag observations; inferred elapsed raw-clock interval, integer microsecond wrapper path; fixed precomputed filter gains
reconstruction.thermal: Current flags+mode, complete >=4 points, signed temperature. Completed LUT assumed if current range known, otherwise actual MLS/cache algorithm. A legacy CSV-supplied complete gyro_tcal curve has explicit separate provenance and uses the same signed firmware MLS; no live mode/flags, LUT range, or offset are inferred. Modern disabled/incomplete/indexed metadata is never reclassified as a legacy curve. No inferred runtime offset or generation rebases. Independent None/Bias/Thermal selection; unavailable thermal curve or recording temperature falls back to static bias/sensitivity. Published thermal diagnostics are actual sensitivity-adjusted curve/explicit-legacy subtraction only, never static fallback or unknown gyro.
reconstruction.limits: No retained filter state, individual chip history, hidden producer loss, actual mag timestamps, runtime D_offset, adaptive/INT_merge history. CMSIS target numerical parity not asserted.
reconstruction.numerical_domain: Sensor and calibrated vectors are bounded before CMSIS float-to-index arithmetic, parameters have supported finite ranges, and nonfinite filter diagnostics fail processing rather than publish a poisoned trajectory.

oracle: crates/tools/src/reference_oracle.rs extracts actual reference wrapper and thermal MLS functions and links actual reference engine. With --cmsis-dsp it uses full external SDK headers/sources independently of the vendored header subset. It never links replay_bridge.c. Default frozen_external_firmware_checkpoints replays all 7200 input events and compares 48 frozen external states in crates/recording/src/replay/fixtures/cmsis_checkpoints.csv (source/trace/fixture hashes in adjacent provenance). Manual firmware_reference_trace compares every state against a regenerated full CSV and reports maximum channel/pose errors. --compare portable.csv quantifies scoped CMSIS differences, not a universal numerical bound.
